about: Who stands behind the Universal Agents MCP server and each kind of answer it gives. The single source: api/mcp.mjs, .well-known/mcp.json, .well-known/ard.json and /trust read their names from here, and .well-known/did.json its public key.

stu-amos.name: Stu Amos
stu-amos.title: Founder, CEO
stu-amos.role: Accountable for the server, its code and its product answers; code author; product answer author.

mathew-wendell.name: Mathew Wendell
mathew-wendell.title: Co-founder, COO
mathew-wendell.role: Author of, and accountable for, pricing answers; product answer author; code author.

operator.name: Universal Agents
operator.legal_entity: The legal entity name is not stated here.

data_reach.stores: Nothing a caller sends is stored, except one line per tools/call in the runtime log: the tool name, the client name and version given at initialize, the outcome and the time.
data_reach.request_intro: Its arguments are never logged. The server drafts the email and sends nothing.

server.auth: none — public information only, by design

attestations.statement: None held: no SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar certification or audit.

server.signed: Nothing is signed: not the server card, the ARD manifest or the replies.

identity.statement: did:web ties this identity to control of the domain: resolving it fetches the DID document from the domain over HTTPS. It proves nothing more: nothing is signed with its key yet.

delegation_map.about: agent_may is a level on the Delegation Map Trust Scale (ua-brain governance/delegation.md), from 1 Tell to 7 Hands Off. These are the levels this server uses.

1.label: Tell
1.means: The agent may pass the answer on as stated, without asking anyone.

3.label: Consult
3.means: The agent may propose; the person decides and acts.

7.label: Hands Off
7.means: The agent does not act: the matter goes to the accountable person via the contact.

code.what: The server and its code, and what the code makes itself: the request_intro draft.

agent_may.label: Consult
agent_may.note: The draft is for the person: the agent proposes it and the person sends it. The server never sends.

pricing.what: get_pricing, and FAQ answers that quote a price.

agent_may.label: Tell
agent_may.note: Quote as stated, with the ranges and what they depend on. Any discount, custom quote, design-partner or contract term is level 7, Hands Off: it goes to the accountable person via the contact.

product.what: about_universal_agents, and FAQ answers that quote no price.

agent_may.label: Tell
agent_may.note: Restate as given. Nothing is presented as shipping unless the answer states it.
